main_text.p: derauit, sed in eundem lapidem, licet „ perspicuè ante ipsius oculos positum, „ cum suo magno malo impegit. Qui, „ cùm regnum eius prospero fortunæ „ flatu ferreretur, & res omnes ad vo- „ luntatem fluerent, sanctos & pios vi- „ ros, qui pro pace eius Imperij, proq; „ vitę incolumitate obnixè Deum pre- „ cabantur, crudeliter exigit, & propte- „ rea vnà cùm illis eorum preces pro „ ipso ad Deum fusas penitus à se aver- „ tit.] In quibus verbis illud inprimis „ animadverti cupio, illos sanctos viros ab hoc Episcopo Sancto appellari, nō qui sanctas uniones adversus sacrosanctam sui Principis personam incunt, aut senten- tiā à Sancta Sede Apostolica, ad illū abdi- candum latam exequi moliuntur ; sed qui pro pace eius Imperij, proq; vitæ incolumitate obnixè Deum precaban- tur: In quorum numero, etiam Cornelium & Lucium Episcopos Romanos re- ponere non dubitarim ; cùm eorum u- trunque sub eodem Gallo martyrio co- ronatum constet.
Quod autem de aliorum Christiano- rum praxi sub Gallo hic memorat Dio- nysius,

page.notes: The scan is slightly blurred at the right edge of the text column. Italic words are read from the scan and marked as italic; the italic "sanctos" and "Sancto" are clear. The line "ponere non dubitarim" and "illū" are read with some uncertainty but are not marked, as the letters are legible. The strip at the far left shows part of the neighbouring page and is excluded.
